project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it sets the same system and device state semantics and discloses any untested raw path.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master defines a two-byte ACPI command but vague acceptance and evidence clearing. DeepSeek replaces it with generic chassis power, which materially changes coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ACPI transition purpose and byte domains are clear. Platform-supported combination, environment and recovery are execution inputs.

review_improvement: Restores exact ACPI semantics, requires an independently observed transition and prevents a generic power shortcut or automatic recovery action.
independent_technical_reasoning: System S-state and device D-state are separate protocol fields. A chassis on/off command can happen to produce a similar visible power result while never exercising the requested device-state byte. Therefore the acceptance oracle must bind the exact request pair to actual platform state and must not infer equivalence from power status alone.
